title: The Brimstone Lift
text: A cage on a black chain goes down into the Pit, swaying in the hot updraft, worked by an imp at a winch who has not stopped grinning since you arrived. It holds four, the imp says, and the slowest will have to wait for the next one.

outcomes.text: Fast, and very hot, and the imp is still grinning when you reach the bottom.

options.label: The slowest takes the stairs alone.

outcomes.text: They arrive much later, singed, limping, and furious, with stories.

options.label: Throw the imp off its winch.

outcomes.text: It falls a long way, still grinning. Its friends below heard it land.
